accepted_findings.claim: setdefault drops duplicate same-name extra dependencies that have different markers or constraints.

evidence_receipt.claim: setdefault drops duplicate same-name extra dependencies that have different markers or constraints.
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: If setdefault were replaced with an assignment or dict that merges/collects multiple dependencies with the same name (e.g. a list keyed by name), the claim would be falsified; as written, setdefault only keeps the first dependency object encountered for each name and silently discards subsequent ones even if they have different markers or version constraints.
